page_title: Design. Prototype. Share. All in one app.

sources.entry: Adobe XD - Tool for designing and prototyping websites and mobile apps.

summary.name: Adobe XD
summary.one_liner: Adobe XD (page titled Adobe Experience Design CC, Beta) is a UX design tool for wireframing, designing, and prototyping websites and mobile apps.
use_cases: Building interactive prototypes for websites and apps
Sharing prototypes with teammates for feedback
Handing off production-ready artwork to developers
Testing the look and feel of a design before building
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Adobe XD as an all-in-one app for designing and prototyping websites and mobile apps. Users can draw, reuse, and remix vector and raster artwork to build wireframes, screen layouts, and production-ready assets in one app. It has a Repeat Grid tool built for XD, plus layers, symbols, and pen tools adapted for UX design. Designers can switch from design mode to prototype mode inside the app, add interactions and transitions, and send a link to teammates and stakeholders for feedback. Artwork can also be shared with developers to build against the specifications.
notable: Repeat Grid tool built specifically for XD
Design and prototype modes switchable within the same app
Shareable prototype links for team and stakeholder review
caveats: The page is an archived marketing page; the Experience Design CC (Beta) naming suggests an early-stage product and current status is not stated
Pricing and supported platforms are not stated in the page text
